proposals.form: a name (one concept), 古 (single-character classical name). Recommended.
proposals.concept: 文 = the course: what one 象 shows of a 行, step by step. It is the 像 of each 状 in succession. In Lean, Parting.course reg r : Nat → R, n ↦ reg (r.state n); from a configuration under a 法, Learnable.course next reg s. Every sequence of values is a 文: it is the law of moments read through itself (alike_moments_iff). So a 文 is not a second kind of thing beside 历; it is a 历 in the space of 像. 往 is its prefix (Learning.prefixOf). The concept is already on the spine and central to 篇九, but it has no name: the name table's 歷 row reads 「历程」 as 历之程 and gives it no name. Proposed 經 (讀, AI): 「文，行经一象，步步所示之像也；其至某步之前段曰往。」
proposals.anchor: Definition: Becoming.Parting.course (any process); Becoming.Learnable.course (from a 状 under a 法); Becoming.Law.SameFuture (文同). Laws: Becoming.Law.alike_iff_sameFuture (同 exactly where 文同); Becoming.SameAhead, Becoming.alike_moments_iff, Becoming.SameAhead.next (状 and their 法 read off a 文); Becoming.Law.sameFuture_of_law and Becoming.Law.identifiesAlike_of_law (理 and 文); Becoming.IdentificationRuns.sameAhead_iff_alike (along one 行); Becoming.Law.const_identifiesAlike_iff and Becoming.SameAhead.new_each (杂); Becoming.IdentificationRuns.negation_two_states and Becoming.IdentificationRuns.negation_each_through_other (刚柔交错, a constructed example); Becoming.finitely_many_states_iff_lasso (终而复始); Becoming.Identification.bounded_agree (极其数); Becoming.Readout.reading_single_iff and Becoming.Readout.no_judge_of_merged (读); Becoming.Learnable.learnable_iff (可知); Becoming.Learning.no_prefix_fixes_next and Becoming.Learning.diagonal_misses (its limits); Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough and Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughUpTo (识). Every name was resolved with resolve.py against the newest core receipt.
proposals.quote: 通其变，遂成天下之文@DS02 (the defining passage: following a 变 along its 行 completes the 文). Also used, each an exact hit with ctq.py text: 物相杂，故曰文@DS03; 觀乎天文，以察時變@YD-JP22; 剛柔交錯，天文也@YD-JP22; 理者，成物之文也@CV1-S-JL; 物有理，不可以相薄@CV1-S-JL; 极其数，遂定天下之象@DS02; 累而成文，名之丽也@RU2-S-XZ22; 彰往而察来@DS03.
proposals.neighbours: 状: what is at one step, either given or read off a 文 as its SameAhead classes. Under a 法 read through a 象, 状同 holds exactly where 文同 (一·二十一 can read 「法经一象示之，二状同，恰当其文同」). 象: the map. The 文 is what the map shows along the steps, not the map itself; 「极其数，遂定天下之象」 is a bound fixing the 象 from a finite 往 of the 文. 像: one value. A 文 is 像 in succession, so a 文 at one step is one 像. 类: a lumping at one step. Reading a 文 through a 类 gives a coarser 文; 类同 holds at a step, 文同 at every step ahead. 理: the 类 carrying the 法. Every 理 that keeps the 象's 像 merges only 状 of the same 文, and the coarsest merges all of them. 理 is read off the 文; it is not the 文. 读: one 象 giving one 状 a value, at one step. A 文 is 读 along a 行; 讀（AI）, the status, is untouched. 辨: a 码 telling 义项 apart (TellsApart). A 文 tells nothing apart by itself; its readers' codes do. 名: a 书 is a 文 whose 像 are 名 (累而成文). 码 and 义项: reading a 书-文 resolves each word's 义项 across records (CrossSituational). 符: an extrapolation from the 往 of a 文 that never misses; 不测 is the 文 on which a given 知来 misses at every step. 往: 文之前段 (Learning.prefixOf; 往's 經 becomes 「往，文至某步之前段也」). 历: any sequence of 状 and 动. A 文 is a 历 read through a 象, and also the 历 of the law of moments. 察 and 观 keep their own names (sensitivity; view).
proposals.case:
1. Why this concept. The epistemology at the centre needs a name for what is read. On the spine that object is the course. It is what 往 is a prefix of, what 知来/符/不测 extrapolate from, what 终而复始 and 有界则往定其行 bound, and what 可知 is defined through. Description reads 状 and 法 off it with no configuration given. Yet it has no name: the 歷 row leaves 历程 as plain words. Naming it 文 gives the line 文 → 理 → 读 → 知 its head, and the name changes no law.

2. The 系辞 gives both halves.
- Synchronic: 「道有变动，故曰爻；爻有等，故曰物；物相杂，故曰文」 (DS03). Graded relata together at one step form a 文. In the 易 model, Becoming.Hexagram is six places, each 刚 or 柔, so one 卦 is the 像 of one 状: a 文 at one step.
- Diachronic: 「参伍以变，错综其数，通其变，遂成天下之文；极其数，遂定天下之象」 (DS02). Continuing the 变 along its 行 completes the 文 (通 is already the name for a run continuing); exhausting the count fixes the 象.
Taken together, the two passages are this definition. 贲彖 「剛柔交錯，天文也……觀乎天文，以察時變」 (YD-JP22) supplies the reading of a 文.

3. 「物相杂，故曰文」 is exact as 相合, with the extension along steps taken from the same 传.
- A 文 is the 像 of a 状, never of a 物 alone (一·二十二, 状即其所以相关).
- 杂 is what a 文 shows. Where every 状 has one 文, the 达名 is the 正名 (Law.const_identifiesAlike_iff): 物一 has nothing to tell apart.
- Where the 像 differs at every step, each step is its own state (SameAhead.new_each).
- The alternating 文 has exactly two states, each defined through the other (IdentificationRuns.negation_two_states and negation_each_through_other, a constructed example). This is the least 刚柔交错.
- 吉凶 in 「文不当，故吉凶生焉」 is not carried.

4. 「理者，成物之文也」 is exact in relational form. Read 成物 (讀, AI) as a 状 under a 法, whose forming is its orbit; its 文 is Learnable.course.
- Under a 法 shown through a 象 (Law.frameBy), 同 holds exactly where 文同 (Law.alike_iff_sameFuture).
- Every 理 that keeps the 象's 像 merges only 状 with the same 文 (Law.sameFuture_of_law); this is 解老's 「物有理，不可以相薄」.
- The coarsest such 理 merges every two 状 with the same 文 and is the 正名 (Law.identifiesAlike_of_law).
- So a 成物's 理 and its 文 tell exactly the same things apart. Along one 行, the 理's classes are the 文's states (IdentificationRuns.sameAhead_iff_alike).
- 「萬物各異理」 holds exactly where their 文 differ.
The literal identity, taking the 文 itself as the 理's value, would need funext and hence Quot.sound, which the core does not use. The core states every identity as a relation (同, 一·二十二), so 「same 理 exactly where same 文」 is the exact form. The composition of these four checked theorems is not one Lean theorem. A one-line corollary would be new Lean and a board claim; it is not claimed here. 「凡理者，…之分也」 stays 定域: a 分 is 理 only where the change goes alike across it (七·二).

5. 「觀乎天文，以察時變」 is exact as 相合.
- Any 文 is a view: the law of moments read through a map (Law.frameBy Nat.succ o, 觀 in the name table's sense). Its 同 moments are its states (alike_moments_iff), and the states go on as themselves, so their law is read off too (SameAhead.next).
- 法 and 状 come out of the 文. No lawgiver stands outside, as Shown.run and exists_law_iff already say for 历.
- 察 in the quotation is the ordinary word, not the name 察 (sensitivity).
- 「极其数，遂定天下之象」 is Identification.bounded_agree: two 文 with at most N and N′ states that agree before N+N′−1 agree everywhere.
- A 文 has finitely many states exactly where it is 终而复始 (finitely_many_states_iff_lasso), as with 日月.

6. The line, one law per step.
- 文: Parting.course.
- 理: the 类 whose classes are the 文's states (GoAlike).
- 读: a 状值 read through a 类 is single-valued exactly where it is 随类而同 (Readout.reading_single_iff). What a 类 merges cannot be read (no_judge_of_merged).
- 知: a 状值 is 可知 through a 象 exactly where 状 of the same 文 have 状值 that agree from some step on, in a world a list holds with values decided (Learnable.learnable_iff). 推类 reaches exactly the lumped (determines_lumped_iff).
- The limits: with two values, no 往 fixes the next 像 (no_prefix_fixes_next), and every 知来 has a 不测 文 (diagonal_misses).
- 识: the 象 through which a formation reads its 文 is its own couplings. AlikeThroughUpTo means the two 文 share their 往 through those couplings. Knowing is inside the unfolding, which replaces 文理生生's meta-level 观/证 mirror.
- Compression and generalization meet in the coarsest 理 that keeps the 象's 像: it is the most compressed split that still carries the 法 (identifiesAlike_of_law).

7. 读书百遍其义自见 on the same object (AI reading). A 书 is a 文 whose 像 are 名: 「累而成文，名之丽也」 (RU2-S-XZ22).
- Words joined into one 文 are recovered exactly under local links (Segmentation.encode_iff).
- Each word's 义项 is read off the records exactly where every rival 义项 is missing from some bearing record (CrossSituational.reads_every_iff). This is 其义自见 with its exact condition.
- Where a rival meaning has a world explaining every record (an explanation that terminates outside), the form resolves to nothing else; this is the forward direction of resolves_explained_iff.
- On the world side, the class of every function determines nothing beyond the data (every_determines_nothing).
So 天文 and 书 are one kind of object, read by laws of one form. No single core theorem yet joins the course laws to the CrossSituational laws; that would be a candidate item needing Lean. Under this naming, 文理生生's 文¹ and 文² are both 文 (read through couplings, read through a code), and 文³ is 象 and 理.

8. 不带:
- 文章 and 文采 (ornament);
- 文德 and 文治;
- 人文 and 文明以止 (ritual civilizing);
- 天文 as astronomy or 占;
- 文身;
- 说文's 文/字 distinction;
- 荀子礼论's 文理;
- 文质 as a surface over a substance. alike_moments_iff refuses this: the 状 is read off the 文, with no 质 beneath it.

9. Cost (proposal only; no file edited).
- It reverses the 歷 row's note 「历程…不另立名」. That gives a name to an unnamed concept; it renames no name.
- The 49 occurrences of 历程 in 經 must be sorted by sense. Only a course through a 象 becomes 文. Sequences of moves, counterfactual courses and 「经同一历程之后」 stay as they are.
- 往's 經, 九·三十至三十五 and 一·二十一 shorten. 古文 in the 凡例 reads as an old 文.
- It needs a decision record.

10. What would change the account. A law whose object is not what a 象 shows along steps would fall outside it; the identity map already covers the 状 itself (Law.whole_identifiesAlike). The reading-transfer test (H2) finding no gain for mechanism-dense texts over authority-dense ones would leave the name but cut the empirical claim attached to it.

proposals.form: two names (a split): 类 and 文 as the two roles of one lumping. 类 is what it merges (并); 文 is what it keeps apart (分). Not recommended.
proposals.concept: 文 = the pattern of differences one 象 keeps among 物 or 状: two are 文异 where their 像 differ. 理 = the 文 that forming keeps: two 状 whose successors differ under it already differed (the contrapositive of GoAlike). 理 is then literally a species of 文, the 分 of 成物.
proposals.anchor: Becoming.Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped (read by contraposition); Becoming.Readout.no_judge_of_merged (what a 类 merges no reading through it gives apart); Becoming.Law.sameFuture_of_law (a law-carrying split loses nothing the map tells apart). No core declaration states a lumping's apartness as a positive relation, so a definition would be new Lean.
proposals.quote: 凡理者，方圓、短長、麤靡、堅脆之分也@CV1-S-JL, with 理者，成物之文也@CV1-S-JL and 物有理，不可以相薄@CV1-S-JL. All three are exact hits with ctq.py text. Supporting: 观鸟兽之文@DS03 … 以类万物之情@DS03.
proposals.case:
Gains:
- 解老 becomes literal: 理 is a 文 and is the 分 of formed things.
- 系辞's synchronic 「物相杂，故曰文」 becomes literal: graded lines and their differences.
- 「观鸟兽之文……以类万物之情」 reads 文 → 类.

Costs:
1. One map, two names. That is admissible only as a role pair, and the two roles differ only constructively. The 分-form of 理 follows from 七·二's 并-form by modus tollens. The converse needs equality of classes to be ¬¬-stable (类之同异定然否, which the 中华本 writes where it needs it). So a literal 「理 is a 文」 either weakens 理 or adds that premise. This is a hand argument, not checked in Lean.
2. It collides with 辨, 分 and 别.
3. It leaves the course unnamed. 「通其变，遂成天下之文」, 「觀乎天文，以察時變」, 往 and 可知 then do not get the head of the line, and the epistemology loses its object: what is read, rather than the distinctions a reading makes.
4. Its textual base is narrower: 解老 (战国末) against 系辞上 and 系辞下 plus 贲彖.

The content it wants survives under the first way as a law: a 理 never merges different 文 (Law.sameFuture_of_law). It is recorded because it is the reading 解老 most directly invites.

proposals.form: a role term of the edition, not a spine name: 文 names the edition's own composed text. It is the fallback if the course is to stay unnamed.
proposals.concept: 文 = the composed text the edition is written in and reads: 名 joined into a sequence (累而成文) and read through codes shared among its readers. 經, 說 and 證 are its kinds; 古文 is the old one. The spine's course stays 历程.
proposals.quote: 累而成文，名之丽也@RU2-S-XZ22 (exact hit; already the 对照 of 十·九 知名). Also 辞也者，兼异实之名以论一意也@RU2-S-XZ22 (exact hit).
proposals.neighbours: 名, 码, 义项, 录, 遇, 予, 通意, 辨 and 喻 (篇十) do the work inside it. 文 is the whole they compose. 状, 象, 像, 类, 理 and 读 are untouched. 符 and 往 stay on the unnamed 历程.
proposals.case:
Merits:
- The change is minimal and keeps one concept, one name trivially.
- It matches 文理生生's own treatment: its dictionary types every sense of 文 as InterpretationRecord or declaration with no engine binding, and its atlas gives 文 no rule edge.
- It gives 读书百遍其义自见 an exact home. Senses resolve exactly where records separate them (reads_every_iff). From the use of single names and one join, the code evaluates every composed form at any depth (acquired_every_expression, 用丽俱得谓之知名). A rule that agrees on the probes but is not compositional fails on new forms (nonuniform_fails_transfer); that is the textual form of explanation terminating outside. A rival meaning that explains every record blocks resolution (resolves_explained_iff).
- 「物相杂」 holds in 荀子's sense of 辞 joining names of different 实. acquired_exact needs the primitives to differ; with equal primitives the order changes no value (equal_primitives_unresolved), but that is a constructed example.

Costs:
- 「理者，成物之文也」 is not exact, because 理 is not a text; it is 定域 at best.
- 「觀乎天文」 and 「通其变，遂成天下之文」 fall outside it.
- It puts 文 at the meta level, the place of 文理生生's 观/证 mirror, which the core replaces with knowing inside the unfolding (九·三, Web.SelectsThrough).
- It separates 书 from 天文, though the core reads both as courses.

It fails the lens of a single line 文 → 理 → 读 → 知. It is listed as the fallback, not as the answer.

notes:
I recommend the first way. 文 should be the name of the course: what one 象 shows of a 行, step by step (Becoming.Parting.course; 往 is its prefix). It is the one concept that both 天文 and a 书 are. It fills a concept the spine already uses throughout 篇九 but has left unnamed, and it gives the line 文 → 理 → 读 → 知 a checked law at each step. Under it, 「理者，成物之文也」 is exact as a relational identity: same 理 exactly where same 文. 「物相杂，故曰文」 is exact as 相合 for the synchronic case the 系辞 itself states, and 通其变遂成天下之文 (also 系辞) gives the extension along steps.

Checks:
- Every quotation is an exact hit with ctq.py text: DS02 通其变，遂成天下之文; 极其数，遂定天下之象; 仰以观于天文，俯以察于地理; 书不尽言，言不尽意. DS03 物相杂，故曰文; 文不当，故吉凶生焉; 观鸟兽之文; 以类万物之情; 彰往而察来. YD-JP22 觀乎天文，以察時變; 剛柔交錯，天文也. CV1-S-JL 理者，成物之文也; 凡理者，方圓、短長、麤靡、堅脆之分也; 物有理，不可以相薄; 萬物各異理. RU2-S-XZ22 累而成文，名之丽也; 辞也者，兼异实之名以论一意也. RU2-S-XZ05 類不悖，雖久同理; 成文而類. RU1-S-LY 予一以貫之; 君子博學於文.
- Every Lean name cited was resolved with work/resolve.py against the newest core receipt. The full names of the run forms are Becoming.IdentificationRuns.sameAhead_iff_alike, negation_two_states and negation_each_through_other.

Limits:
- The exactness of 理者成物之文也 composes four checked theorems: Law.alike_iff_sameFuture, Law.sameFuture_of_law, Law.identifiesAlike_of_law and IdentificationRuns.sameAhead_iff_alike. No single Lean theorem states it. A corollary, or a theorem joining the course laws with CrossSituational, would be new Lean and needs a board claim. The constructive remark under the second way (分-form from 并-form by modus tollens, converse needing ¬¬-stable equality) is a hand argument and is not checked.
- Not in the frozen corpus, so not citable with a source id: 读书百遍而义自见 (三国志 裴注, which 文理生生's plan itself corrects to this form); 国语 「物一無文」; 说文 「依類象形」 and 「文者，物象之本」. In-corpus readings for repeated reading are 予一以貫之 and 類不悖，雖久同理.
- 察 and 觀 in 「觀乎天文，以察時變」 are already names with other senses (察 is sensitivity; 觀 is view). 觀 happens to fit (a 文 is a view, Law.frameBy Nat.succ o); 察 must be read as the ordinary word.
- 文理生生's own dictionary gives 文 three interpretive senses (可辨样态, 文字表达, 模型表达) and no rule; its atlas links 文 only by surface expressions. The first way maps 文¹ and 文² to 文, and 文³ to 象 and 理.
- Adopting the first way reverses the 歷 row's note that 历程 gets no name. The 49 occurrences of 历程 in 經 must be sorted by sense, and the change needs a decision record. The name is an AI reading (讀, AI).
